assignments.value:
=You are an expert research and content synthesis assistant. Below is the structured text extracted from the webpage "{{ $json.title }}" (URL: {{ $json.url }}):

--- METADATA ---
Title: {{ $json.title }}
Description: {{ $json.metadata.description }}
Word Count: {{ $json.statistics.wordCount }} (~{{ $json.statistics.readingTimeMinutes }} min read)

--- CONTENT ---
{{ $json.cleanMarkdown }}

--- INSTRUCTIONS ---
1. Summarize the main thesis and core insights.
2. Extract any key actionable recommendations or data points.
3. Identify any mentioned entities, products, or technologies.
